   229	/-! ## The law of the projected sample -/
   230	
   231	/-- A point of the combined space is recovered from its two parts. -/
   232	@[simp] theorem combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart
   233	    {K : Type*} {m k : ℕ} (z : Fin (m + k) → K) :
   234	    combinedPoint (combinedPointPart z) (combinedCoefficientPart z) = z := by
   235	  funext i
   236	  rw [combinedPoint]
   237	  rcases hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | r
   238	  · show combinedPointPart z j = z i
   239	    rw [combinedPointPart, combinedPointVar, ← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   240	  · show combinedCoefficientPart z r = z i
   241	    rw [combinedCoefficientPart, combinedCoefficientVar, ← hi,
   242	      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

   244	/-- The decomposition of a sample of the combined game into its two point
   245	parts, its two combining parts, and its coordinate index. -/
   246	private def directCombinedSpaceEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   247	    DirectLdSpace D.combined ≃
   248	      (((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
   249	        (((Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) ×
   250	          Fin D.combined.m)) where
   251	  toFun sample :=
   252	    ((directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
   253	        directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction),
   254	      ((directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.point,
   255	        directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.direction), sample.index))
   256	  invFun x :=
   257	    ⟨combinedPoint x.1.1 x.2.1.1, x.2.2, combinedPoint x.1.2 x.2.1.2⟩
   258	  left_inv sample := by
   259	    obtain ⟨point, index, direction⟩ := sample
   260	    dsimp only
   261	    congr 1 <;>
   262	      first
   263	        | rfl
   264	        | exact combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart _
   265	  right_inv x := by
   266	    obtain ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨α, w⟩, i⟩ := x
   267	    dsimp only
   268	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
   269	    exact ⟨⟨combinedPointPart_combinedPoint u α,
   270	        combinedPointPart_combinedPoint v w⟩,
   271	      ⟨combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint u α,
   272	        combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint v w⟩, trivial⟩
   273	
   274	/-- The distributional half of `lem:ld-combined-question-law`: the two point
   275	parts of a uniform sample of the combined game are jointly uniform, hence
   276	independent of the combining parts and of the coordinate index.  Together with
   277	`directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar` this says that, conditioned on a
   278	point coordinate index, the questions measured by the combined strategy are the
   279	canonical questions of a uniform sample of the original game. -/
   280	theorem directCombinedSample_pointParts_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
   281	    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D.combined)).map
   282	        (fun sample => (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
   283	          directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction)) =
   284	      uniformDistribution
   285	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) :=
   286	  uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (e := directCombinedSpaceEquiv D) _
   287	    fun _ => rfl
   288	
   289	/-- The coordinate index of a uniform sample of the combined game is uniform on
   290	the `m + k` coordinates of the combined dimension; this is the index of
   291	`lem:ld-combined-question-law`, whose two cases are the point coordinates and
   292	the combining coordinates. -/
   293	theorem directCombinedSample_index_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
   294	    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D.combined)).map
   295	        (fun sample => sample.index) =
   296	      uniformDistribution (Fin D.combined.m) :=
   297	  uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (e := directLdSpaceIndexEquiv D.combined)
   298	    _ fun _ => rfl
   299	
   300	/-- The decomposition of a sample of the combined game into its coordinate
   301	index and its two point parts on the one side, and its two combining parts on
   302	the other. -/
   303	private def directCombinedSpaceIndexEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
   304	    DirectLdSpace D.combined ≃
   305	      ((Fin D.combined.m ×
   306	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))) ×
   307	        ((Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D))) where
   308	  toFun sample :=
   309	    ((sample.index,
   310	        (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
   311	          directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction)),
   312	      (directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.point,
   313	        directCombinedCoefficientPart D sample.direction))
   314	  invFun x := ⟨combinedPoint x.1.2.1 x.2.1, x.1.1, combinedPoint x.1.2.2 x.2.2⟩
   315	  left_inv sample := by
   316	    obtain ⟨point, index, direction⟩ := sample
   317	    dsimp only
   318	    congr 1 <;>
   319	      first
   320	        | rfl
   321	        | exact combinedPoint_combinedPointPart_combinedCoefficientPart _
   322	  right_inv x := by
   323	    obtain ⟨⟨i, u, v⟩, α, w⟩ := x
   324	    dsimp only
   325	    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
   326	    exact ⟨⟨trivial, combinedPointPart_combinedPoint u α,
   327	        combinedPointPart_combinedPoint v w⟩,
   328	      combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint u α,
   329	      combinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint v w⟩
   330	
   331	/-- The distributional half of `lem:ld-combined-question-law`: the coordinate
   332	index of a uniform sample of the combined game and the two point parts of that
   333	sample are jointly uniform on the product of the `m + k` coordinates with two
   334	copies of `F_q^m`.  Conditioned on a point coordinate index, the point parts
   335	are therefore uniform, so by
   336	`directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar` the questions measured by the
   337	combined strategy are the canonical questions of a uniform sample of the
   338	original game at the same ordered type pair; conditioned on a combining
   339	coordinate index, the point part of the sampled point is uniform, so by
   340	`directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_coefficientVar` both measured questions are
   341	the point question at a uniform point.  This single statement subsumes the two
   342	marginal laws `directCombinedSample_pointParts_uniform` and
   343	`directCombinedSample_index_uniform`, which it refines by recording that the
   344	index and the point parts are independent. -/
   345	theorem directCombinedSample_indexPointParts_uniform (D : DirectLdParams) :
   346	    (uniformDistribution (DirectLdSpace D.combined)).map
   347	        (fun sample => (sample.index,
   348	          (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
   349	            directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction))) =
   350	      uniformDistribution
   351	        (Fin D.combined.m ×
   352	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))) :=
   353	  uniformDistribution_map_fst_of_equiv (e := directCombinedSpaceIndexEquiv D) _
   354	    fun _ => rfl

     3	/-!
     4	# Branch-wise acceptance transport for the combined strategy
     5	
     6	By `directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le`, the branch-wise estimates of
     7	`lem:ld-combined-value` reduce to the following statement: the relabelling of
     8	`def:ld-combined-strategy` sends an answer pair accepted by the win predicate
     9	of the original game at the measured questions to an answer pair accepted by
    10	the win predicate of the combined game.  This module proves that statement for
    11	each of the nine ordered type pairs of the combined game.
    12	
    13	Three of the nine branches are deterministic.  The two questions of a branch
    14	whose type pair is diagonal are equal, so the acceptance clause of the original
    15	game forces the two measured outcomes to be equal, and the relabelling, being a
    16	function, sends them to equal combined outcomes.  The two branches pairing an
    17	axis-parallel line with a diagonal line impose no condition in either game.
    18	
    19	The six remaining branches pair a line with a point, and split according to
    20	whether the stored coordinate index of the common sample is a point coordinate
    21	or a combining coordinate.  On a point coordinate the acceptance clause of the
    22	combined game is obtained from the acceptance clause of the original game by
    23	the affine change of parameter `directCombinedRebaseParameter`: the parameter
    24	presenting the sampled point on the sampled line of the combined space presents
    25	the point part of the sampled point on the image line, after the shift.  On a
    26	combining coordinate the sampled line lies in a fiber of the projection to the
    27	point coordinates, the combining part of the sampled point is the affine
    28	function `α₀ + t w` of the parameter, and the acceptance clause of the combined
    29	game is the identity `∑ r (α₀ + t w)_r b_r = ∑ r α_r b_r`.
    30	
    31	All declarations below are formalization-only support for
    32	`lem:ld-combined-value`; none is a paper-labelled result.
    33	
    34	## References
    35	
    36	* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
    37	* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
    38	* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:526-568`
    39	-/
    40	
    41	open scoped BigOperators
    42	
    43	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    44	
    45	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    46	open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries

    62	/-- The coordinate direction of a point coordinate of the combined dimension

    65	    (D : DirectLdParams) (j : Fin D.m) :

    67	        (coordinateDirection (combinedPointVar D.m D.k j)) = 0 := by

    76	private theorem diagonalDegreeBound (D : DirectLdParams) :

    79	  calc D.m * D.d + 1 ≤ D.m * D.d + D.k * D.d := Nat.add_le_add_left h1 _

    86	/-! ## Evaluation of the combined answers -/

    88	/-- Evaluation of the answer of cases 3 and 5 of `def:ld-combined-strategy`:

    93	private theorem fiberAnswerEval (D : DirectLdParams) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    94	    (z base dirn : Fin D.combined.m → DirectScalarQ D)
    95	    (b : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) (t : DirectScalarQ D)
    96	    (ht : z = base + t • dirn) :

    98	        (coefficientsOfPolynomial n
    99	          (fiberLinePolynomial (directCombinedCoefficientPart D base)
   100	            (directCombinedCoefficientPart D dirn) b)) t =
   101	      ∑ r : Fin D.k, directCombinedCoefficientPart D z r * b r := by
   102	  have hz : directCombinedCoefficientPart D z =
   103	      directCombinedCoefficientPart D base +
   104	        t • directCombinedCoefficientPart D dirn := by
   105	    conv_lhs => rw [ht]

   108	      (le_trans (fiberLinePolynomial_natDegree_le _ _ _) hn),

   121	    (hf : ∀ r, evalCoefficient (f r) (t + s) = c r)
   122	    (ht : z = base + t • dirn) :
   123	    evalCoefficient
   124	        (coefficientsOfPolynomial D.combined.d
   125	          (combinedAxisPolynomial (directCombinedCoefficientPart D base) s f)) t =
   126	      ∑ r : Fin D.k, directCombinedCoefficientPart D z r * c r := by
   127	  have hz : directCombinedCoefficientPart D z = directCombinedCoefficientPart D base := by
   128	    conv_lhs => rw [ht]
   129	    rw [directCombinedCoefficientPart_add_smul, hdir, smul_zero, add_zero]
   130	  rw [evalCoefficient_coefficientsOfPolynomial
   131	      (le_trans (combinedAxisPolynomial_natDegree_le _ _ _)
   132	        (le_of_eq (DirectLdParams.combined_d D).symm)),

   136	/-- Evaluation of the answer of case 4 of `def:ld-combined-strategy`: along a
   137	diagonal line of the combined space with a point coordinate as stored index,
   138	the combining part of the point at parameter `t` is `α₀ + t w`, and the shifted
   139	parameter presents the point part of that point on the measured line. -/
   140	private theorem diagonalAnswerEval (D : DirectLdParams)
   141	    (z base dirn : Fin D.combined.m → DirectScalarQ D) (s t : DirectScalarQ D)
   142	    (f : Fin D.k → Fin (D.m * D.d + 1) → DirectScalarQ D)
   143	    (c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)
   144	    (hf : ∀ r, evalCoefficient (f r) (t + s) = c r)
   145	    (ht : z = base + t • dirn) :
   146	    evalCoefficient
   147	        (coefficientsOfPolynomial (D.combined.m * D.combined.d)
   148	          (combinedDiagonalPolynomial (directCombinedCoefficientPart D base)
   149	            (directCombinedCoefficientPart D dirn) s f)) t =
   150	      ∑ r : Fin D.k, directCombinedCoefficientPart D z r * c r := by
   151	  have hz : directCombinedCoefficientPart D z =
   152	      directCombinedCoefficientPart D base +
   153	        t • directCombinedCoefficientPart D dirn := by
   154	    conv_lhs => rw [ht]
   155	    exact directCombinedCoefficientPart_add_smul D base dirn t

   166	/-- An answer pair accepted at two equal questions of the directly indexed game
   167	consists of two equal answers: the three diagonal clauses of
   168	`def:ld-win-predicate` are equalities of answers. -/
   169	theorem directLdAnswer_eq_of_win_self (D : DirectLdParams)
   170	    (q : DirectLdQuestion D) {a b : DirectLdAnswer D}
   171	    (hwin : directLdWinPredicate D q q a b = true) : a = b := by
   172	  obtain ⟨t, xq⟩ := q
   173	  cases t <;> cases a <;> cases b <;>
   174	    simp_all [directLdWinPredicate, validDirectLdAnswer]

   177	questions of the directly indexed game. -/
   178	theorem directLdWinPredicate_self (D : DirectLdParams) (q : DirectLdQuestion D)
   179	    (a : DirectLdAnswer D) (hvalid : validDirectLdAnswer q.1 a = true) :
   180	    directLdWinPredicate D q q a a = true := by
   181	  obtain ⟨t, xq⟩ := q
   182	  cases t <;> cases a <;>
   183	    simp_all [directLdWinPredicate, validDirectLdAnswer]

   185	/-- The relabelling of `def:ld-combined-strategy` always produces an answer of
   186	the constructor required by the type of the combined question. -/
   187	theorem validDirectLdAnswer_directCombinedAnswerMap (D : DirectLdParams)
   188	    (q : DirectLdQuestion D.combined) (a : DirectLdAnswer D) :
   189	    validDirectLdAnswer q.1 (directCombinedAnswerMap D q a) = true := by
   190	  obtain ⟨t, xq⟩ := q
   191	  cases t
   192	  · rfl
   193	  · rcases hsplit : directCombinedIndexSplit D xq.index with j | r <;>
   194	      simp only [directCombinedAnswerMap, hsplit, validDirectLdAnswer]
   195	  · rcases hsplit : directCombinedIndexSplit D xq.index with j | r <;>
   196	      simp only [directCombinedAnswerMap, hsplit, validDirectLdAnswer]

   198	/-- An ordered pair of a well-formed axis-parallel line answer and a well-formed
   199	diagonal line answer is accepted: `def:ld-win-predicate` imposes no condition on

   244	theorem directCombinedAxisAnswer_eval (D : DirectLdParams)
   245	    (z dir : Fin D.combined.m → DirectScalarQ D)
   246	    (hcoef : directCombinedCoefficientPart D dir = 0) (s T : DirectScalarQ D)

   252	    (hT : z = lineRepMap dir z + T • dir)

   254	      directCombinedPointPart D z =
   255	          lineRepMap (directCombinedPointPart D dir) (directCombinedPointPart D z) +
   256	            t • directCombinedPointPart D dir →

   305	/-- The acceptance transport of `lem:ld-combined-value` on one ordered type
   306	pair: the relabelling of `def:ld-combined-strategy` sends an answer pair
   307	accepted by the win predicate of the original game at the measured questions to
   308	an answer pair accepted by the win predicate of the combined game. -/
   309	def DirectCombinedWinTransport (D : DirectLdParams) (t₁ t₂ : LdType)
   310	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D.combined) : Prop :=
   311	  ∀ a b : DirectLdAnswer D,
   312	    directLdWinPredicate D
   313	        (directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D (t₁, directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample))
   314	        (directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D (t₂, directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample))
   315	        a b = true →
   316	      directLdWinPredicate D.combined
   317	        (t₁, directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample) (t₂, directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample)
   318	        (directCombinedAnswerMap D (t₁, directLdMap D.combined t₁ sample) a)
   319	        (directCombinedAnswerMap D (t₂, directLdMap D.combined t₂ sample) b) = true

   325	  intro a b hwin

   328	      eq_combinedPointVar_of_indexSplit D hsplit
   329	    rw [directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar D .aline j sample hindex,
   330	      directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar D .point j sample hindex] at hwin

   338	      | pointVals c =>
   339	        have hsplitL : directCombinedIndexSplit D
   340	            (directLdMap D.combined LdType.aline sample).index = Sum.inl j := hsplit

     4	/-!
     5	# The value of the combined strategy
     6	
     7	`lem:ld-combined-value` transports the value of a projective strategy along
     8	`def:ld-combined-strategy`.  Both games weight their nine ordered type pairs
     9	uniformly, so it suffices to bound the rejection probability of each branch of
    10	the combined game by a bounded number of branch rejection probabilities of the
    11	original game.  Splitting a branch according to the event of
    12	`lem:ld-combined-question-law`, the branch conditioned on a point coordinate
    13	index is the branch of the original game at the same ordered type pair, and the
    14	branch conditioned on a combining coordinate index is the point-versus-point
    15	branch of the original game; on each of the two events the relabelling of
    16	`def:ld-combined-strategy` carries acceptance to acceptance, which is
    17	`directCombinedWinTransport_all`.  Each branch of the combined game is therefore
    18	rejected with probability at most the sum of two branch rejection probabilities
    19	of the original game, and summing over the nine branches multiplies the
    20	rejection probability by at most ten.
    21	
    22	## References
    23	
    24	* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1409-1503`
    25	* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
    26	* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:526-568`
    27	-/
    28	
    29	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    30	
    31	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    32	
    33	open MIPStarRE.LDT

    38	
    39	/-- The rejected mass of the original strategy at the pair of questions
    40	measured by the combined strategy, as a function of the coordinate index and of
    41	the two point parts of the sample of the combined game.  By
    42	`lem:ld-combined-question-law` those three data determine the measured pair. -/
    43	def directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass (D : DirectLdParams)
    44	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (types : LdType × LdType)
    45	    (i : Fin D.combined.m)
    46	    (pd : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) : ℝ :=
    47	  match directCombinedIndexSplit D i with
    48	  | .inl j =>
    49	      directRejectedMass D S
    50	        (types.1, directLdMap D types.1 ⟨pd.1, j, pd.2⟩)
    51	        (types.2, directLdMap D types.2 ⟨pd.1, j, pd.2⟩)
    52	  | .inr _ =>
    53	      directRejectedMass D S (directLdPointQuestionOf D pd.1)
    54	        (directLdPointQuestionOf D pd.1)
    55	
    56	/-- Branch-wise rejected-mass comparison at a fixed sample of the combined
    57	game: the acceptance transport of `directCombinedWinTransport_all` bounds the
    58	rejected mass of the combined strategy by the rejected mass of the original
    59	strategy at the measured questions, which `lem:ld-combined-question-law`
    60	identifies. -/
    61	theorem directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le_measured (D : DirectLdParams)
    62	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (types : LdType × LdType)
    63	    (sample : DirectLdSpace D.combined) :
    64	    directRejectedMass D.combined (directCombinedStrategy D S)
    65	        (types.1, directLdMap D.combined types.1 sample)
    66	        (types.2, directLdMap D.combined types.2 sample) ≤
    67	      directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types sample.index
    68	        (directCombinedPointPart D sample.point,
    69	          directCombinedPointPart D sample.direction) := by
    70	  refine le_trans (directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le D S _ _
    71	    (directCombinedWinTransport_all D types.1 types.2 sample)) (le_of_eq ?_)
    72	  rcases hsplit : directCombinedIndexSplit D sample.index with j | r
    73	  · have hindex : sample.index = combinedPointVar D.m D.k j :=
    74	      eq_combinedPointVar_of_indexSplit D hsplit
    75	    rw [directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar D types.1 j sample hindex,
    76	      directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_pointVar D types.2 j sample hindex]
    77	    simp only [directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass, hsplit,
    78	      directCombinedSampleProjection]
    79	  · have hindex : sample.index = combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r :=
    80	      eq_combinedCoefficientVar_of_indexSplit D hsplit
    81	    rw [directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_coefficientVar D types.1 r sample hindex,
    82	      directCombined_measuredQuestion_of_coefficientVar D types.2 r sample hindex]
    83	    simp only [directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass, hsplit]
    84	
    85	/-- Conditioned on a point coordinate index, the measured pair is the canonical
    86	pair of the original game at the same ordered type pair attached to a uniform
    87	sample. -/
    88	theorem avgOver_directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass_pointVar (D : DirectLdParams)
    89	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (types : LdType × LdType) (j : Fin D.m) :
    90	    avgOver (uniformDistribution
    91	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
    92	      (directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types
    93	        (combinedPointVar D.m D.k j)) =
    94	      directLdIndexedBranchRejectionProbability D S types j := by
    95	  apply avgOver_congr
    96	  intro pd
    97	  simp only [directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass,
    98	    directCombinedIndexSplit_combinedPointVar]
    99	
   100	/-- Conditioned on a combining coordinate index, both measured questions are
   101	the point question at a uniform point, so the branch reduces to the
   102	point-versus-point branch of the original game. -/
   103	theorem avgOver_directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass_coefficientVar
   104	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   105	    (types : LdType × LdType) (r : Fin D.k) :
   106	    avgOver (uniformDistribution
   107	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   108	      (directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types
   109	        (combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r)) =
   110	      directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .point) := by
   111	  have hcongr : avgOver (uniformDistribution
   112	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   113	      (directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types
   114	        (combinedCoefficientVar D.m D.k r)) =
   115	      avgOver (uniformDistribution
   116	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   117	        (fun pd => (fun (u _ : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) =>
   118	          directRejectedMass D S (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)
   119	            (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)) pd.1 pd.2) := by
   120	    apply avgOver_congr
   121	    intro pd
   122	    simp only [directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass,
   123	      directCombinedIndexSplit_combinedCoefficientVar]
   124	  rw [hcongr, avgOver_uniform_prod
   125	      (f := fun (u _ : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) =>
   126	        directRejectedMass D S (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)
   127	          (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)),
   128	    directLdBranchRejectionProbability_point_point_eq]
   129	  apply avgOver_congr
   130	  intro _
   131	  exact avgOver_uniform_const _
   132	
   133	/-- Branch-wise half of `lem:ld-combined-value`: every branch of the combined
   134	game is rejected with probability at most the sum of the branch of the original
   135	game at the same ordered type pair and its point-versus-point branch. -/
   136	theorem directLdBranchRejectionProbability_directCombinedStrategy_le
   137	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D))
   138	    (types : LdType × LdType) :
   139	    directLdBranchRejectionProbability D.combined (directCombinedStrategy D S)
   140	        types ≤
   141	      directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types +
   142	        directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .point) := by
   143	  classical
   144	  have hstep : directLdBranchRejectionProbability D.combined
   145	      (directCombinedStrategy D S) types ≤
   146	      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.combined.m ×
   147	        ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))))
   148	        (fun x => directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types x.1 x.2) := by
   149	    rw [directLdBranchRejectionProbability_eq_avgOver,
   150	      ← directCombinedSample_indexPointParts_uniform D, Distribution.avgOver_map]
   151	    exact avgOver_mono _ _ _ fun sample =>
   152	      directRejectedMass_directCombinedStrategy_le_measured D S types sample
   153	  refine le_trans hstep ?_
   154	  rw [avgOver_uniform_prod (f := fun i pd =>
   155	      directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types i pd),
   156	    avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
   157	  have hmkNat : D.combined.m = D.m + D.k := rfl
   158	  have hmpos : 0 < D.m := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hm
   159	  have hkpos : 0 < D.k := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one D.hk
   160	  have hcard : (D.m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hmpos.ne'
   161	  have hmk : ((D.combined.m : ℕ) : ℝ) = (D.m : ℝ) + (D.k : ℝ) := by
   162	    rw [hmkNat]
   163	    push_cast
   164	    ring
   165	  have hsum : ∑ i : Fin D.combined.m,
   166	      avgOver (uniformDistribution
   167	          ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   168	        (fun pd => directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types i pd) =
   169	      (∑ j : Fin D.m, directLdIndexedBranchRejectionProbability D S types j) +
   170	        (D.k : ℝ) * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .point) := by
   171	    show ∑ i : Fin (D.m + D.k),
   172	        avgOver (uniformDistribution
   173	            ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   174	          (fun pd => directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types i pd) = _
   175	    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
   176	    congr 1
   177	    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
   178	      exact avgOver_directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass_pointVar D S types j
   179	    · have hconst : ∀ r : Fin D.k,
   180	          avgOver (uniformDistribution
   181	              ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)))
   182	            (fun pd => directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass D S types
   183	              (Fin.natAdd D.m r) pd) =
   184	            directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .point) := fun r =>
   185	        avgOver_directCombinedMeasuredRejectedMass_coefficientVar D S types r
   186	      simp [hconst, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
   187	  have hbranch : ∑ j : Fin D.m,
   188	      directLdIndexedBranchRejectionProbability D S types j =
   189	      (D.m : ℝ) * directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types := by
   190	    rw [directLdBranchRejectionProbability_eq_avgOver_index,
   191	      avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
   192	    field_simp
   193	  rw [hsum, hbranch, hmk]
   194	  have hB : 0 ≤ directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S types :=
   195	    directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S types
   196	  have hP : 0 ≤ directLdBranchRejectionProbability D S (.point, .point) :=
   197	    directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S (.point, .point)
   198	  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < D.m := by exact_mod_cast hmpos
   199	  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < D.k := by exact_mod_cast hkpos
   200	  rw [inv_mul_eq_div, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
   201	  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm.le hP, mul_nonneg hk.le hB]
   202	
   203	/-- `lem:ld-combined-value`, rejection form.  Both the directly indexed
   204	low-degree game with the original parameters and the one with the combined
   205	parameters weight their nine ordered type pairs uniformly, so averaging the
   206	branch-wise bound over the nine pairs bounds the rejection probability of the
   207	combined strategy by the rejection probability of the original strategy plus
   208	its point-versus-point branch; that branch is in turn at most nine times the
   209	rejection probability of the original strategy.  The universal constant of the
   210	source statement is therefore `10`. -/
   211	theorem directLdRejectionProbability_directCombinedStrategy_le
   212	    (D : DirectLdParams) (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) :
   213	    directLdRejectionProbability D.combined (directCombinedStrategy D S) ≤
   214	      10 * directLdRejectionProbability D S := by
   215	  have hle := directLdBranchRejectionProbability_directCombinedStrategy_le D S
   216	  have hnn := directLdBranchRejectionProbability_nonneg D S
   217	  rw [directLdRejectionProbability, directLdRejectionProbability,
   218	    avgOver_ldType_pair, avgOver_ldType_pair]
   219	  linarith [hle (.point, .point), hle (.point, .aline), hle (.point, .dline),
   220	    hle (.aline, .point), hle (.aline, .aline), hle (.aline, .dline),
   221	    hle (.dline, .point), hle (.dline, .aline), hle (.dline, .dline),
   222	    hnn (.point, .point), hnn (.point, .aline), hnn (.point, .dline),
   223	    hnn (.aline, .point), hnn (.aline, .aline), hnn (.aline, .dline),
   224	    hnn (.dline, .point), hnn (.dline, .aline), hnn (.dline, .dline)]
   225	
   226	/-- `lem:ld-combined-value`: if a projective strategy succeeds with probability
   227	at least `1 - ε` in the directly indexed low-degree game with the original
   228	parameters, then the combined strategy of `def:ld-combined-strategy` succeeds
   229	with probability at least `1 - 10 ε` in the directly indexed low-degree game
   230	with the combined parameters.  The universal constant of the source statement
   231	is `10`. -/
   232	theorem directCombinedStrategy_value_ge (D : DirectLdParams)
   233	    (S : Strategy (directLdGame D)) (ε : ℝ) (hvalue : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) :
   234	    1 - 10 * ε ≤ (directCombinedStrategy D S).value := by
   235	  have hcomb := directLdRejectionProbability_directCombinedStrategy_le D S
   236	  rw [directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value,
   237	    directLdRejectionProbability_eq_one_sub_value] at hcomb
   238	  linarith
   239	
   240	end

     3	/-!
     4	# The joint recovery estimate in the point and combining variables
     5	
     6	`lem:ld-combining-recovery` compares the tuple of values at a point of the
     7	components recovered from an outcome of the combined game with the tuple of
     8	answers of the point measurement of the original game.  The comparison rests on
     9	a joint estimate over the sampled point `u` and the sampled combining vector
    10	`α`: for every outcome `p` of the combined game and every tuple `b` of scalars,
    11	the event that the recovered tuple of values at `u` differs from `b` while the
    12	value of `p` at the combined point agrees with the combination `∑_r α_r b_r`
    13	has probability at most `(m + k) d / q`.
    14	
    15	Two cases occur.  If `p` is the combined polynomial of a tuple `g`, its value at
    16	the combined point is the combination `∑_r α_r g_r(u)`, and two combinations
    17	with distinct coefficient tuples agree at a uniformly sampled `α` with
    18	probability at most `1 / q`.  If `p` is not combined, then by
    19	`lem:ld-combining-exact-linearity` its restriction `p(u, ·)` fails to be a
    20	linear form except with probability `m d / q` over `u`, and off that event the
    21	restriction and the linear form of `b` are distinct polynomials of total degree
    22	at most `k d`, so they agree at a uniformly sampled `α` with probability at
    23	most `k d / q`.
    24	
    25	The estimate is recorded in two stages, because the consistency calculus
    26	averages it against Born weights which depend on the sampled point but not on
    27	the sampled combining vector: a bound at a fixed point which does not depend on
    28	the tuple `b`, and the average of that bound over the point.
    29	
    30	## Main statements
    31	
    32	* `directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound` — the bound at a fixed point.
    33	* `directCombinedRecoveryEvent_avg_le` — the estimate at a fixed point.
    34	* `directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound_avg_le` — the average of the bound at a
    35	  fixed point over a uniformly sampled point.
    36	* `directCombinedRecoveryBadEvent_avg_le` — the joint estimate of
    37	  `lem:ld-combining-recovery`.
    38	
    39	## References
    40	
    41	* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1440-1503`
    42	* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
    43	* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:617-680`
    44	-/
    45	
    46	open scoped BigOperators
    47	
    48	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    49	
    50	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    51	open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    52	
    53	noncomputable section
    54	
    55	/-! ## Elementary facts about the parameters -/
    56	
    57	/-- The field size of a directly indexed low-degree game is positive. -/
    58	theorem directLdFieldSize_pos (D : DirectLdParams) : (0 : ℝ) < (D.q : ℝ) := by
    59	  have h : 0 < Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) := Fintype.card_pos
    60	  rw [card_directScalarQ] at h
    61	  exact_mod_cast h
    62	
    63	/-- Commuting the two factors of a combination of a tuple of scalars. -/
    64	private theorem directCombiningSum_comm {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] {k : ℕ}
    65	    (c α : Fin k → K) : ∑ r : Fin k, α r * c r = ∑ r : Fin k, c r * α r :=
    66	  Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _
    67	
    68	/-- The rational bound produced by the Schwartz--Zippel estimates, read in the
    69	field size of the directly indexed game. -/
    70	private theorem directCombiningRatio_eq (D : DirectLdParams) (n : ℕ) :
    71	    ((((n : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card (DirectScalarQ D) : ℚ≥0) : Error) =
    72	      ((n : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by
    73	  rw [card_directScalarQ]
    74	  push_cast
    75	  ring
    76	
    77	/-! ## The collision estimates in the combining variables -/
    78	
    79	open scoped Classical in
    80	/-- Collision of two combinations with distinct coefficient tuples, written with
    81	the combining vector as the left factor. -/
    82	private theorem directCombiningCollision_avg_le_comm (D : DirectLdParams)
    83	    (c b : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) (hne : c ≠ b) :
    84	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D))
    85	        (fun α => if ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * c r = ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then
    86	          (1 : Error) else 0) ≤ (1 : Error) / D.q := by
    87	  refine le_trans (le_of_eq (avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun α => ?_))
    88	    (directCombiningCollision_avg_le D c b hne)
    89	  rw [directCombiningSum_comm c α, directCombiningSum_comm b α]
    90	
    91	set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
    92	open scoped Classical in
    93	/-- Collision of a restriction which is not a linear form with the linear form
    94	of a tuple of scalars, written with the combining vector as the left factor. -/
    95	private theorem directCombinedRestrictCollision_avg_le (D : DirectLdParams)
    96	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
    97	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (b : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)
    98	    (hu : ∀ c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D,
    99	      combinedRestrict p.1 u ≠ combiningLinearForm c) :
   100	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D))
   101	        (fun α => if MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) p.1 =
   102	          ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0) ≤
   103	      ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by
   104	  have hkd : 1 ≤ D.k * D.d := by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul D.hk D.hd
   105	  have hbound := combinedRestrict_collision_avg_le (d := D.d) p.2 hkd u b hu
   106	  refine le_trans (le_of_eq (avgOver_congr _ _ _ fun α => ?_))
   107	    (le_trans hbound (le_of_eq (directCombiningRatio_eq D (D.k * D.d))))
   108	  rw [directCombiningSum_comm b α]
   109	
   110	/-! ## The estimate at a fixed point -/
   111	
   112	open scoped Classical in
   113	/-- The bound at a fixed point of the recovery step: the collision probability
   114	`1 / q` of two combinations when the outcome is combined, and otherwise the
   115	indicator that the restriction of the outcome at the point is a linear form
   116	together with the collision probability `k d / q` of two polynomials of total
   117	degree at most `k d` in the combining variables. -/
   118	def directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound (D : DirectLdParams)
   119	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
   120	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) : Error :=
   121	  if IsDirectCombined D p then (1 : Error) / D.q
   122	  else
   123	    (if ∃ c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D,
   124	        combinedRestrict p.1 u = combiningLinearForm c then (1 : Error) else 0) +
   125	      ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q
   126	
   127	/-- The bound at a fixed point of the recovery step is nonnegative. -/
   128	theorem directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound_nonneg (D : DirectLdParams)
   129	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
   130	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) :
   131	    0 ≤ directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p u := by
   132	  classical
   133	  have hq := directLdFieldSize_pos D
   134	  have hkd : (0 : Error) ≤ ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by positivity
   135	  rw [directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound]
   136	  split_ifs
   137	  · positivity
   138	  · linarith
   139	  · linarith
   140	
   141	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   142	open scoped Classical in
   143	/-- Estimate at a fixed point of `lem:ld-combining-recovery`.  For a fixed
   144	outcome `p` of the combined game, a fixed point `u` and a fixed tuple `b` of
   145	scalars, the probability, over a uniformly sampled combining vector `α`, that
   146	the tuple of values at `u` of the components recovered from `p` differs from `b`
   147	while the value of `p` at the combined point with parts `u` and `α` equals the
   148	combination `∑_r α_r b_r`, is at most the bound at the point.  The bound does
   149	not depend on the tuple `b`. -/
   150	theorem directCombinedRecoveryEvent_avg_le (D : DirectLdParams)
   151	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
   152	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (b : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) :
   153	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun α =>
   154	        if evalDirectPolyTupleAt u (directTupleOfCombined D p) ≠ b ∧
   155	            MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) p.1 =
   156	              ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0) ≤
   157	      directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p u := by
   158	  classical
   159	  have hq := directLdFieldSize_pos D
   160	  rw [directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound]
   161	  by_cases hc : IsDirectCombined D p
   162	  · rw [if_pos hc]
   163	    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hc
   164	    subst hg
   165	    rw [directTupleOfCombined_directCombinedPolynomial]
   166	    by_cases hub : evalDirectPolyTupleAt u g = b
   167	    · have hzero : ∀ α : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D,
   168	          (if evalDirectPolyTupleAt u g ≠ b ∧
   169	              MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α)
   170	                  (directCombinedPolynomial D g).1 =
   171	                ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0) = 0 := by
   172	        intro α
   173	        refine if_neg ?_
   174	        rintro ⟨hne, -⟩
   175	        exact hne hub
   176	      rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hzero, avgOver_zero]
   177	      positivity
   178	    · refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _
   179	        (fun α => if ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * evalDirectPolyTupleAt u g r =
   180	          ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0) fun α => ?_)
   181	        (directCombiningCollision_avg_le_comm D _ b hub)
   182	      by_cases hev : evalDirectPolyTupleAt u g ≠ b ∧
   183	          MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α)
   184	              (directCombinedPolynomial D g).1 =
   185	            ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r
   186	      · have h2 := hev.2
   187	        rw [directCombinedPolynomial_eval] at h2
   188	        rw [if_pos hev, if_pos h2]
   189	      · rw [if_neg hev]
   190	        split_ifs
   191	        · exact zero_le_one
   192	        · exact le_rfl
   193	  · rw [if_neg hc]
   194	    by_cases hu : ∃ c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D,
   195	        combinedRestrict p.1 u = combiningLinearForm c
   196	    · rw [if_pos hu]
   197	      have hkd : (0 : Error) ≤ ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by positivity
   198	      refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ (fun _ => (1 : Error)) fun α => ?_) ?_
   199	      · split_ifs
   200	        · exact le_rfl
   201	        · exact zero_le_one
   202	      · rw [avgOver_uniform_const]
   203	        linarith
   204	    · rw [if_neg hu, zero_add]
   205	      push Not at hu
   206	      refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _
   207	        (fun α => if MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) p.1 =
   208	          ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0) fun α => ?_)
   209	        (directCombinedRestrictCollision_avg_le D p u b hu)
   210	      split_ifs with h1 h2
   211	      · exact le_rfl
   212	      · exact absurd h1.2 h2
   213	      · exact zero_le_one
   214	      · exact le_rfl

   216	/-! ## The averaged estimate -/
   217	
   218	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   219	open scoped Classical in
   220	/-- The bound at a fixed point of the recovery step averages to at most
   221	`(m + k) d / q` over a uniformly sampled point.  For a combined outcome the
   222	bound is the constant `1 / q`; for a non-combined outcome the indicator that the
   223	restriction is a linear form averages to at most `m d / q` by
   224	`lem:ld-combining-exact-linearity`. -/
   225	theorem directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound_avg_le (D : DirectLdParams)
   226	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d) :
   227	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
   228	        (directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p) ≤
   229	      ((D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by
   230	  classical
   231	  have hq := directLdFieldSize_pos D
   232	  have hsplit : ((D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q =
   233	      ((D.m * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q + ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by
   234	    have hn : (D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) = D.m * D.d + D.k * D.d := by
   235	      simp [DirectLdParams.combined_m, Nat.add_mul]
   236	    rw [hn]
   237	    push_cast
   238	    ring
   239	  by_cases hc : IsDirectCombined D p
   240	  · have hconst : ∀ u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   241	        directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p u = (1 : Error) / D.q := by
   242	      intro u
   243	      rw [directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound, if_pos hc]
   244	    rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hconst, avgOver_uniform_const]
   245	    have h1 : (1 : Error) ≤ ((D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) : Error) := by
   246	      have hle : 1 ≤ D.combined.m * D.d := by
   247	        simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul D.combined.hm D.combined.hd
   248	      exact_mod_cast hle
   249	    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hq.le
   250	  · have hlin := directCombinedExactLinearity_avg_le D p hc
   251	    have heq : ∀ u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D,
   252	        directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p u =
   253	          (if ∃ c : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D,
   254	              combinedRestrict p.1 u = combiningLinearForm c then (1 : Error)
   255	            else 0) + ((D.k * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q := by
   256	      intro u
   257	      rw [directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound, if_neg hc]
   258	    rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ heq, avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, hsplit]
   259	    linarith [hlin]
   260	
   261	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   262	open scoped Classical in
   263	/-- Joint estimate of `lem:ld-combining-recovery`.  For a fixed outcome `p` of
   264	the combined game and a fixed tuple `b` of scalars, the probability, over a
   265	uniformly sampled point `u` of the original space and a uniformly sampled
   266	combining vector `α`, that the tuple of values at `u` of the components
   267	recovered from `p` differs from `b` while the value of `p` at the combined point
   268	with parts `u` and `α` equals the combination `∑_r α_r b_r`, is at most
   269	`(m + k) d / q`. -/
   270	theorem directCombinedRecoveryBadEvent_avg_le (D : DirectLdParams)
   271	    (p : PolyIndex D.combined.m (DirectScalarQ D) D.d)
   272	    (b : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) :
   273	    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun u =>
   274	        avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) (fun α =>
   275	          if evalDirectPolyTupleAt u (directTupleOfCombined D p) ≠ b ∧
   276	              MvPolynomial.eval (combinedPoint u α) p.1 =
   277	                ∑ r : Fin D.k, α r * b r then (1 : Error) else 0)) ≤
   278	      ((D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) : Error) / D.q :=
   279	  le_trans
   280	    (avgOver_mono _ _ (directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound D p)
   281	      fun u => directCombinedRecoveryEvent_avg_le D p u b)
   282	    (directCombinedRecoveryLocalBound_avg_le D p)
   283	
   284	end

     4	/-!
     5	# Transporting a consistency relation along the recovery step
     6	
     7	The recovery step of `lem:ld-combining-recovery` replaces a relation between a
     8	point measurement of the original strategy read through a combination and a
     9	measurement of the combined game read at a point of the combined space by a
    10	relation between the point measurement itself and the same measurement read
    11	through the recovered polynomial tuple.  This module isolates the consistency
    12	calculus of that replacement, in a form which does not mention the low-degree
    13	game.
    14	
    15	Both relations are diagonal overlaps of the same pair of measurements placed on
    16	opposite tensor factors, and the two relabellings differ only on the event that
    17	the recovered outcome disagrees with the outcome of the point measurement while
    18	the two relabellings agree.  The probability of that event, averaged over the
    19	auxiliary sample, is bounded at each question by a quantity depending only on
    20	the outcome of the second measurement; since the first measurement is complete,
    21	the total Born weight of an outcome of the second measurement does not depend on
    22	the question, and the bound may therefore be averaged over the question against
    23	that weight.
    24	
    25	The two conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness` transported here place the point
    26	measurement on opposite tensor factors, so the calculus is recorded twice, once
    27	for each placement; the two statements share the averaging estimate, which is
    28	insensitive to the placement.
    29	
    30	## Main statements
    31	
    32	* `consistencyDefect_le_of_recoveryBound` — the transport of a consistency
    33	  relation along a relabelling which is correct off a rare event, with the
    34	  point measurement on the first tensor factor.
    35	* `consistencyDefect_le_of_recoveryBound_right` — the same transport with the
    36	  point measurement on the second tensor factor.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1440-1503`
    41	* `references/qpbt-paper/06_nonlocal_games_and_mipstar.tex:219-288`
    42	* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:617-680`
    43	-/
    44	
    45	open scoped BigOperators MatrixOrder Matrix ComplexOrder
    46	
    47	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    48

    50	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    59	
    60	/-- The diagonal overlap of a measurement against a relabelled measurement on the
    61	opposite factor is the sum over pairs of outcomes with matching labels. -/
    62	private theorem diagonalRight_pair_sum {β Γ ιA ιB : Type*}
    63	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    64	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    65	    (A : Measurement β ιA) (B : Measurement Γ ιB)
    66	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (f : Γ → β) :
    67	    (∑ b : β, stateQForm ψ
    68	      (heteroKron (A.effect b) ((B.postprocess f).effect b))) =
    69	      ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f g = b then
    70	        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect b) (B.effect g)) else 0 := by
    71	  classical
    72	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    73	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    74	    heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    75	
    76	/-- The diagonal overlap of a relabelled measurement against a measurement on
    77	the opposite factor, with the relabelled measurement on the first factor. -/
    78	private theorem diagonalLeft_pair_sum {β Γ ιA ιB : Type*}
    79	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    80	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    81	    (A : Measurement β ιB) (B : Measurement Γ ιA)
    82	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (f : Γ → β) :
    83	    (∑ b : β, stateQForm ψ
    84	      (heteroKron ((B.postprocess f).effect b) (A.effect b))) =
    85	      ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f g = b then
    86	        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (B.effect g) (A.effect b)) else 0 := by
    87	  classical
    88	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
    89	  rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    90	    heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    91	
    92	/-- The diagonal overlap of two relabelled measurements on opposite factors is
    93	the sum over pairs of outcomes with matching labels. -/
    94	private theorem diagonalPair_pair_sum {β Γ R ιA ιB : Type*}
    95	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
    96	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    97	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
    98	    (A : Measurement β ιA) (B : Measurement Γ ιB)
    99	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (e : β → R) (f : Γ → R) :
   100	    (∑ r : R, stateQForm ψ
   101	      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess e).effect r) ((B.postprocess f).effect r))) =
   102	      ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e b = f g then
   103	        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect b) (B.effect g)) else 0 := by
   104	  classical
   105	  have hterm (r : R) : stateQForm ψ
   106	      (heteroKron ((A.postprocess e).effect r) ((B.postprocess f).effect r)) =
   107	      ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e b = r ∧ f g = r then
   108	        stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (A.effect b) (B.effect g)) else 0 := by
   109	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   110	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
   111	      heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
   112	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   113	    by_cases hb : e b = r
   114	    · rw [if_pos hb, heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum,
   115	        Finset.sum_filter]
   116	      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
   117	      by_cases hg : f g = r <;> simp [hb, hg]
   118	    · simp [hb]
   119	  simp_rw [hterm]
   120	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   121	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   122	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   123	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
   124	  by_cases hbg : e b = f g
   125	  · rw [hbg]
   126	    simp
   127	  · refine Eq.trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun r _ => ?_) (by simp [hbg])
   128	    simp only [ite_eq_right_iff]
   129	    intro hpair
   130	    exact (hbg (hpair.1.trans hpair.2.symm)).elim
   131	
   132	/-- The diagonal overlap of two relabelled measurements on opposite factors,
   133	with the second measurement on the first tensor factor. -/
   134	private theorem diagonalPairLeft_pair_sum {β Γ R ιA ιB : Type*}
   135	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
   136	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   137	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]

   139	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (e : β → R) (f : Γ → R) :

   152	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_

   154	    · rw [if_pos hb, heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum,

   161	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
   162	  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

   172	/-! ## The averaging estimate -/
   173	
   174	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   175	/-- The averaging estimate underlying the recovery transport, stated for the
   176	Born weights alone.  The weights `w x b g` of a pair of outcomes have fiber
   177	sums `W g` independent of the question `x`, and the two diagonal overlaps
   178	differ only on the discrepancy event, whose conditional probability is bounded
   179	by `F x g`; averaging that bound against the fiber weights gives `η`. -/
   180	private theorem recovery_avg_le {X Y β Γ R : Type*}
   181	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
   182	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
   183	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
   184	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   185	    (w : X → β → Γ → ℝ) (W : Γ → ℝ)
   186	    (f : X → Γ → β) (e₁ : X → Y → β → R) (f₁ : X → Y → Γ → R)
   187	    (F : X → Γ → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
   188	    (hwnonneg : ∀ x b g, 0 ≤ w x b g) (hWnonneg : ∀ g, 0 ≤ W g)
   189	    (hfiber : ∀ x g, (∑ b : β, w x b g) = W g) (hWsum : (∑ g : Γ, W g) = 1)
   190	    (hFbound : ∀ x b g, avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
   191	      (fun y => if f x g ≠ b ∧ e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ F x g)
   192	    (hFavg : ∀ g, avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x => F x g) ≤ η) :
   193	    avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x =>
   194	        avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y =>
   195	          ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0)) ≤
   196	      avgOver (uniformDistribution X)
   197	        (fun x => ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) + η := by
   198	  classical
   199	  have hstep : ∀ x : X,
   200	      avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y =>
   201	          ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0) ≤
   202	        (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   203	          ∑ g : Γ, W g * F x g := by
   204	    intro x
   205	    have hexp : avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (fun y =>
   206	        ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0) =
   207	        ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
   208	          (fun y => if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0) := by
   209	      rw [avgOver_sum]
   210	      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => avgOver_sum _ _
   211	    rw [hexp]
   212	    have hterm : ∀ b : β, ∀ g : Γ,
   213	        avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
   214	          (fun y => if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0) ≤
   215	          (if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) + w x b g * F x g := by
   216	      intro b g
   217	      have hsplit : ∀ y : Y,
   218	          (if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0) ≤
   219	            (if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   220	              (if f x g ≠ b ∧ e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
   221	                w x b g := by
   222	        intro y
   223	        by_cases hy : e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g
   224	        · by_cases hb : f x g = b
   225	          · rw [if_pos hy, if_pos hb, if_neg, zero_mul, add_zero]
   226	            rintro ⟨hne, -⟩
   227	            exact hne hb
   228	          · rw [if_pos hy, if_neg hb, if_pos ⟨hb, hy⟩, one_mul, zero_add]
   229	        · rw [if_neg hy]
   230	          have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if f x g = b then w x b g else 0 := by
   231	            split_ifs
   232	            · exact hwnonneg x b g
   233	            · exact le_rfl
   234	          have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤
   235	              (if f x g ≠ b ∧ e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then (1 : ℝ) else 0) *
   236	                w x b g := by
   237	            have : (0 : ℝ) ≤
   238	                if f x g ≠ b ∧ e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then (1 : ℝ) else 0 := by
   239	              split_ifs
   240	              · exact zero_le_one
   241	              · exact le_rfl
   242	            exact mul_nonneg this (hwnonneg x b g)
   243	          linarith
   244	      refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ hsplit) ?_
   245	      rw [avgOver_add, avgOver_uniform_const, avgOver_mul_const]
   246	      have hcomm : w x b g * F x g = F x g * w x b g := mul_comm _ _
   247	      linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hFbound x b g) (hwnonneg x b g)]
   248	    refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
   249	      Finset.sum_le_sum fun g _ => hterm b g) ?_
   250	    have hsum : (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ,
   251	        ((if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) + w x b g * F x g)) =
   252	        (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   253	          ∑ g : Γ, (∑ b : β, w x b g) * F x g := by
   254	      calc (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ,
   255	            ((if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) + w x b g * F x g))
   256	          = ∑ b : β, ((∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   257	              ∑ g : Γ, w x b g * F x g) :=
   258	            Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => Finset.sum_add_distrib
   259	        _ = (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   260	              ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, w x b g * F x g := Finset.sum_add_distrib

   262	              ∑ g : Γ, (∑ b : β, w x b g) * F x g := by
   263	            congr 1
   264	            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   265	            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
   266	    have hW2 : (∑ g : Γ, (∑ b : β, w x b g) * F x g) =
   267	        ∑ g : Γ, W g * F x g :=
   268	      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => by rw [hfiber x g]
   269	    rw [hsum, hW2]
   270	  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ hstep) ?_

260	              ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, w x b g * F x g := Finset.sum_add_distrib
   261	        _ = (∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0) +
   262	              ∑ g : Γ, (∑ b : β, w x b g) * F x g := by
   263	            congr 1
   264	            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   265	            exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => (Finset.sum_mul _ _ _).symm
   266	    have hW2 : (∑ g : Γ, (∑ b : β, w x b g) * F x g) =
   267	        ∑ g : Γ, W g * F x g :=
   268	      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => by rw [hfiber x g]
   269	    rw [hsum, hW2]
   270	  refine le_trans (avgOver_mono _ _ _ hstep) ?_
   271	  rw [avgOver_add]
   272	  have hswap : avgOver (uniformDistribution X)
   273	      (fun x => ∑ g : Γ, W g * F x g) =
   274	      ∑ g : Γ, W g * avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x => F x g) := by
   275	    rw [avgOver_sum]
   276	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => avgOver_const_mul _ _ _
   277	  have hfinal : avgOver (uniformDistribution X)

   281	      (∑ g : Γ, W g * avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x => F x g)) ≤

   284	          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hFavg g) (hWnonneg g)
   285	      _ = η := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hWsum, one_mul]

   294	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   295	/-- Transport of a consistency relation along the recovery relabelling, with
   296	the point measurement on the first tensor factor.  The point measurement is
   297	complete at every question, so the total Born weight of an outcome of the
   298	second measurement does not depend on the question; the bound on the
   299	discrepancy event may therefore be averaged over the question against that
   300	weight, and the defect of the recovered relation exceeds the defect of the
   301	relation with the auxiliary sample by at most the resulting average. -/
   302	theorem consistencyDefect_le_of_recoveryBound
   303	    {X Y β Γ R ιA ιB : Type*}
   304	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Nonempty X]
   305	    [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] [Nonempty Y]
   306	    [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β] [Fintype Γ] [DecidableEq Γ]
   307	    [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
   308	    [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   309	    (A : X → Measurement β ιA) (B : Measurement Γ ιB)
   310	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (hψ : ‖ψ‖ = 1)
   311	    (f : X → Γ → β) (e₁ : X → Y → β → R) (f₁ : X → Y → Γ → R)
   312	    (F : X → Γ → ℝ) (η : ℝ)
   313	    (hFbound : ∀ x b g, avgOver (uniformDistribution Y)
   314	      (fun y => if f x g ≠ b ∧ e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ F x g)
   315	    (hFavg : ∀ g, avgOver (uniformDistribution X) (fun x => F x g) ≤ η) :
   316	    consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   317	        (fun x b => heteroKron ((A x).effect b) 1)
   318	        (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ ≤
   319	      consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (X × Y))
   320	        (fun z r => heteroKron (((A z.1).postprocess (e₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r) 1)
   321	        (fun z r => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r)) ψ + η := by
   322	  classical
   323	  set w : X → β → Γ → ℝ := fun x b g =>
   324	    stateQForm ψ (heteroKron ((A x).effect b) (B.effect g)) with hwdef
   325	  have hwnonneg : ∀ x b g, 0 ≤ w x b g := fun x b g =>
   326	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg ((A x).pos b) (B.pos g))
   327	  set W : Γ → ℝ := fun g => stateQForm ψ (heteroKron (1 : Op ιA) (B.effect g))
   328	    with hWdef
   329	  have hWnonneg : ∀ g, 0 ≤ W g := fun g =>
   330	    stateQForm_nonneg ψ (MIPStarRE.Quantum.kronecker_nonneg
   331	      (Matrix.PosSemidef.one.nonneg : (0 : Op ιA) ≤ 1) (B.pos g))
   332	  have hfiber : ∀ x g, (∑ b : β, w x b g) = W g := by
   333	    intro x g
   334	    rw [hwdef, hWdef]
   335	    simp only
   336	    rw [← (A x).sum_eq_one, heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum]
   337	  have hWsum : (∑ g : Γ, W g) = 1 := by
   338	    rw [hWdef]
   339	    simp only
   340	    rw [← stateQForm_finset_sum, ← heteroKron_finset_sum_right, B.sum_eq_one,
   341	      heteroKron_one_one, stateQForm_one, hψ, one_pow]
   342	  -- the two diagonal overlaps
   343	  set AgrG : X → ℝ := fun x =>
   344	    ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if f x g = b then w x b g else 0 with hAgrG
   345	  set AgrH : X → Y → ℝ := fun x y =>
   346	    ∑ b : β, ∑ g : Γ, if e₁ x y b = f₁ x y g then w x b g else 0 with hAgrH
   347	  have hgoal : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution X)
   348	      (fun x b => heteroKron ((A x).effect b) 1)
   349	      (fun x b => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b)) ψ =
   350	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution X) AgrG := by
   351	    rw [consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point (uniformDistribution X) A
   352	      (fun x => B.postprocess (f x))]
   353	    have hpoint : ∀ x : X,
   354	        (∑ b : β, ∑ b' : β, if b = b' then 0 else stateQForm ψ
   355	          (heteroKron ((A x).effect b) ((B.postprocess (f x)).effect b'))) =
   356	          1 - AgrG x := by
   357	      intro x
   358	      have h := point_defect_eq (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) (A x))
   359	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (B.postprocess (f x))) ψ
   360	      simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   361	        MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at h
   362	      simp_rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at h
   363	      rw [h, hψ, one_pow, hAgrG]
   364	      simp only
   365	      rw [diagonalRight_pair_sum (A x) B ψ (f x)]
   366	    rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hpoint, avgOver_sub, avgOver_uniform_const]
   367	  have hhyp : consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (X × Y))
   368	      (fun z r => heteroKron (((A z.1).postprocess (e₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r) 1)
   369	      (fun z r => heteroKron 1 ((B.postprocess (f₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r)) ψ =
   370	      1 - avgOver (uniformDistribution X)
   371	        (fun x => avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (AgrH x)) := by
   372	    rw [consistencyDefect_placed_eq_avg_point (uniformDistribution (X × Y))
   373	      (fun z => (A z.1).postprocess (e₁ z.1 z.2))
   374	      (fun z => B.postprocess (f₁ z.1 z.2))]
   375	    have hpoint : ∀ z : X × Y,
   376	        (∑ r : R, ∑ r' : R, if r = r' then 0 else stateQForm ψ
   377	          (heteroKron (((A z.1).postprocess (e₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r)
   378	            ((B.postprocess (f₁ z.1 z.2)).effect r'))) =
   379	          1 - AgrH z.1 z.2 := by
   380	      intro z
   381	      have h := point_defect_eq
   382	        (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := ιB) ((A z.1).postprocess (e₁ z.1 z.2)))
   383	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := ιA) (B.postprocess (f₁ z.1 z.2))) ψ
   384	      simp only [leftPlacedMeasurement, rightPlacedMeasurement,
   385	        MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.ofSumEqOne] at h
   386	      simp_rw [placed_product_stateQForm_eq] at h
   387	      rw [h, hψ, one_pow, hAgrH]
   388	      simp only
   389	      rw [diagonalPair_pair_sum (A z.1) B ψ (e₁ z.1 z.2) (f₁ z.1 z.2)]
   390	    rw [avgOver_congr _ _ _ hpoint, avgOver_sub, avgOver_uniform_const,
   391	      avgOver_uniform_prod (fun x y => AgrH x y)]
   392	  rw [hgoal, hhyp]
   393	  have hkey : avgOver (uniformDistribution X)
   394	      (fun x => avgOver (uniformDistribution Y) (AgrH x)) ≤
   395	      avgOver (uniformDistribution X) AgrG + η := by
   396	    rw [hAgrG, hAgrH]
   397	    exact recovery_avg_le w W f e₁ f₁ F η hwnonneg hWnonneg hfiber hWsum
   398	      hFbound hFavg
   399	  linarith

     5	/-!
     6	# The recovery of the polynomial-tuple measurements
     7	
     8	`lem:ld-combining-recovery` turns the three conclusions of `lem:ld-soundness`
     9	for the combined strategy at the combined parameters into the three conclusions
    10	for the original strategy at the original parameters, by post-processing the
    11	measurements of the combined game with the recovery map of
    12	`def:ld-combining-map`.
    13	
    14	The two point relations are wired by the abstract transport of
    15	`Transport.Combining.RecoveryDefect`.  At a point `(u, α)` of the combined
    16	space the point measurement of the combined strategy is the point measurement
    17	of the original strategy at `u` post-processed by the combination with
    18	coefficients `α`, and the polynomial measurement of the combined game read at
    19	that point is the same measurement read through the recovery map and then
    20	combined with the same coefficients; the two families therefore differ only on
    21	the discrepancy event of `Recovery`, whose average is `(m + k) d / q`.  The
    22	uniform law on the combined space is the product of the uniform laws on the
    23	point part and on the combining part, which is the reindexing along
    24	`directCombinedPointEquiv`.
    25	
    26	The polynomial relation is data processing: the recovered measurements are
    27	post-processings of the measurements of the combined game.
    28	
    29	## Main statements
    30	
    31	* `directCombinedPointEquiv` — the point of the combined space with given
    32	  point and combining parts, as an identification.
    33	* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_one` — the first conclusion.
    34	* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_two` — the second conclusion.
    35	* `directCombinedRecovery_relation_three` — the third conclusion.
    36	
    37	## References
    38	
    39	* `references/neexp-paper/05_quantum_preliminaries.tex:1440-1503`
    40	* `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`
    41	* `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:617-680`
    42	-/

    56	
    57	/-- The identification of a point of the combined space with the pair formed by
    58	its point part and its combining part. -/
    59	def directCombinedPointEquiv (D : DirectLdParams) :
    60	    ((Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) ≃
    61	      (Fin D.combined.m → DirectScalarQ D) where
    62	  toFun z := combinedPoint z.1 z.2
    63	  invFun z := (directCombinedPointPart D z, directCombinedCoefficientPart D z)
    64	  left_inv z := by
    65	    have h1 : directCombinedPointPart D (combinedPoint z.1 z.2) = z.1 :=
    66	      directCombinedPointPart_combinedPoint D z.1 z.2
    67	    have h2 : directCombinedCoefficientPart D (combinedPoint z.1 z.2) = z.2 :=
    68	      directCombinedCoefficientPart_combinedPoint D z.1 z.2
    69	    show (directCombinedPointPart D (combinedPoint z.1 z.2),
    70	      directCombinedCoefficientPart D (combinedPoint z.1 z.2)) = z
    71	    rw [h1, h2]
    72	  right_inv z := by
    73	    funext i
    74	    show Sum.elim (fun j => z (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inl j)))
    75	      (fun r => z (finSumFinEquiv (Sum.inr r))) (finSumFinEquiv.symm i) = z i
    76	    rcases hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with j | r
    77	    · simp only [Sum.elim_inl]
    78	      rw [← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    79	    · simp only [Sum.elim_inr]
    80	      rw [← hi, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

    83	    (z : (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) × (Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D)) :
    84	    directCombinedPointEquiv D z = combinedPoint z.1 z.2 := rfl
    85	
    86	/-! ## The point measurement of the combined strategy -/
    87	
    88	/-- On a point question of the combined game the combined strategy measures the
    89	point question of the original game at the point part. -/
    90	private theorem directCombinedMeasuredQuestion_point (D : DirectLdParams)
    91	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (α : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) :
    92	    directCombinedMeasuredQuestion D
    93	        (directLdPointQuestionOf D.combined (combinedPoint u α)) =
    94	      directLdPointQuestionOf D u := by
    95	  show directLdPointQuestionOf D
    96	    (directCombinedPointPart D (combinedPoint u α)) = _
    97	  rw [directCombinedPointPart_combinedPoint]

    99	/-- On a point question of the combined game the combined answer, read as a
   100	one-component tuple of scalars, is the combination of the measured point answer
   101	with the combining part of the sampled point. -/
   102	private theorem directCombinedPointAnswerMap_comp (D : DirectLdParams)
   103	    (u : Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D) (α : Fin D.k → DirectScalarQ D) :
   104	    (fun a : DirectLdAnswer D => directLdPointValuesOrZero D.combined
   105	        (directCombinedAnswerMap D

    45	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex`, needed by the Chapter 15
    46	combining argument at paper
    47	`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1267-1288`.
    48	
    49	This is a formalization auxiliary assertion, not the source-labelled
    50	`lem:ld-soundness`.  Of the two obligations catalogued in the cited gap note the
    51	auxiliary-parameter bound is established, by the choice of sampling parameter,
    52	and it is not hidden as a hypothesis; the game correspondence is neither
    53	established nor hidden, but avoided, since the statement speaks about the
    54	directly indexed game rather than the game of `def:ld-game`.  Relating the two
    55	games remains open.
    56	The measurements are those of `prop:ld-simultaneous-general-k`, and the
    57	universal constants exhibited are `a = 10^23` and `b = 1/80000`: for
    58	`0 < ε ≤ 1` the error of that proposition is absorbed into `deltaLd` by
    59	`exists_directCombinedTransportConstants`, and for `1 ≤ ε` the error function
    60	is at least one while every bipartite consistency defect on a unit state is at
    61	most one. -/
    62	theorem exists_direct_ld_soundness :
    63	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
    64	      ∀ (D : DirectLdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
    65	        ∀ S : Strategy (directLdGame D), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
    66	          ∃ GA : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιA,
    67	            ∃ GB : DirectPolyMeasTuple D S.ιB,
    68	              consistencyDefect
    69	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    70	                  (fun u outcome =>
    71	                    heteroKron
    72	                      (((S.A (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    73	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome) 1)
    74	                  (fun u outcome =>
    75	                    heteroKron 1
    76	                      ((GB.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
    77	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
    78	              consistencyDefect
    79	                  (uniformDistribution (Fin D.m → DirectScalarQ D))
    80	                  (fun u outcome =>
    81	                    heteroKron
    82	                      ((GA.postprocess (evalDirectPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
    83	                  (fun u outcome =>
    84	                    heteroKron 1
    85	                      (((S.B (directLdPointQuestionOf D u)).postprocess
    86	                        (directLdPointValuesOrZero D)).effect outcome))
    87	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k ∧
    88	              consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
    89	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
    90	                  (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
    91	                  S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε D.q D.m D.d D.k := by
    92	  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb0, hb1, habs⟩ := exists_directCombinedTransportConstants
    93	  refine ⟨a, b, ha, hb0, hb1, ?_⟩
    94	  intro D ε hε S hS hwin
    95	  obtain ⟨GA, GB, h1, h2, h3⟩ :=
    96	    exists_directSimultaneousPolynomialMeasurements_combinedError D S hS ε hwin
    97	  refine ⟨GA, GB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    98	  all_goals by_cases hε1 : ε ≤ 1
    99	  · exact le_trans h1 (habs D ε hε hε1)
   100	  · exact le_trans
   101	      (consistencyDefect_heteroKron_le_one _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) _ _
   102	        S.ψ S.ψ_norm)
   103	      (one_le_deltaLd_of_one_le_error ha hb0.le (not_le.mp hε1).le D.hm D.hd D.hk)
   104	  · exact le_trans h2 (habs D ε hε hε1)
   105	  · exact le_trans
   106	      (consistencyDefect_heteroKron_le_one _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) _ _
   107	        S.ψ S.ψ_norm)
   108	      (one_le_deltaLd_of_one_le_error ha hb0.le (not_le.mp hε1).le D.hm D.hd D.hk)
   109	  · refine le_trans h3 (le_trans ?_ (habs D ε hε hε1))
   110	    have hloss : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.combined.m * D.d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D.q : ℝ) := by positivity
   111	    linarith
   112	  · exact le_trans
   113	      (consistencyDefect_heteroKron_le_one _ (uniformDistribution_isProbability _) _ _
   114	        S.ψ S.ψ_norm)
   115	      (one_le_deltaLd_of_one_le_error ha hb0.le (not_le.mp hε1).le D.hm D.hd D.hk)
   116
